faq.title: No marketing fog.
faq.jira_a: No. VibeUs starts before Jira: at the moment someone sees a problem but cannot yet turn it into a reproducible engineering task.
faq.ai_q: Does AI change the code by itself?
faq.ai_a: VibeUs does not require a particular AI. It passes structured context to your IDE/agent while code-change permissions remain in your local workflow.
faq.staging_q: Do I need a staging deployment?
faq.staging_a: Not necessarily. Live Preview can temporarily expose a local dev server through a restricted link. In production it must use a separate preview origin.
faq.browser_q: What is sent from the browser?
faq.browser_a: By default the product follows a minimum-necessary model: element context and technical diagnostics without request/response bodies or secrets. Enhanced diagnostics must be enabled explicitly.
faq.selfhost_a: Yes. Open-source/self-hosting is a first-class path: it reduces vendor lock-in and supports teams with infrastructure or residency requirements.
faq.ru_pay_q: How do payments work in Russia?
faq.ru_pay_a: The primary Russian flow is YooKassa / SBP / MIR or manual B2B invoicing. Early paid access uses 30-day periods with manual renewal rather than pretending a recurring engine is available.
